HistorySyncWithTTS.description_en:
Specifies whether the LLM message history is synchronized with the content played by the TTS. Default: `false`. When enabled, the saved LLM messages match the content actually played by the TTS.

When a user interrupts the agent, the `<ims_agent_interrupted>` tag is inserted into the message history at the point of interruption. This affects the next message sent to the LLM. For example:

```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a story."},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "Okay, I can tell you a story about the Three Kingdoms. Would you<ims_agent_interrupted> like that?"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "Tell me a different one."}
]
```
HistorySyncWithTTS.description_zh:
大模型消息历史，是否和tts播放内容保持一致。默认false。开启后，保存的大模型消息和tts播放内容保持一致。

大模型消息历史中当用户打断Agent时，下次发送给大模型的 message 会在打断位置插入 <ims_agent_interrupted> 标签。比如：

```
[
  {"role": "user", "content": "给我讲一个故事。"},
  {"role": "assistant", "content": "好的，我给你讲一个三国演义的故事吧，你<ims_agent_interrupted>想听吗？"},
  {"role": "user", "content": "换一个吧。"}
]
```

Eagerness.description_en:
Controls the agent's response speed after detecting a user pause. This parameter applies only in `Semantic` mode. A higher setting results in a faster response but increases the risk of interrupting the user:

`Low`: Waits patiently with a maximum wait time of 6 seconds, reducing the risk of interruption.

`Medium`: A balanced wait time (up to 4 seconds), suitable for most scenarios.

`High`: Responds quickly (up to 2 seconds), which improves speed but may increase the risk of incorrect turn-taking.

This field is empty by default

"Medium"：平衡等待（最长等待时间4秒），适用大多数场景。
"High"：快速响应（最长等待时间2秒），提升速度但可能增加误切风险。

字段默认空

Volume.description_en:
The speaking volume of the AI agent.

If not set, the adaptive volume mode recommended by Alibaba Cloud is used by default.

If set, the value must be in the range of 0 to 400. The final output volume is calculated as: `(Workflow volume) * (volume / 100)`. For example:

If `volume` is 0, the output volume is 0.

If `volume` is 100, the output volume is the same as the original volume.

If `volume` is 200, the output volume is twice the original volume
Volume.description_zh:

若 volume=200，音量等于原声音量的 2 倍

VoiceId.description_zh: 音色ID，修改后下句话生效。不填写则使用智能体模版配置的音色ID。仅针对预置TTS生效。输入长度不超过64。[智能语音效果示例]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449563.html）

VoiceprintId.description_en: The unique ID for voiceprint recognition. Default: not specified
VoiceprintId.description_zh: 声纹识别的唯一身份ID。默认值：不填

Volume.description_en:
The speaking volume of the agent.

If omitted, the system uses adaptive volume mode.

If specified, the valid range is 0 to 400. The output volume is calculated as: `Output Volume in Workflow` * (`volume`/100). For example:

If `volume` is `0`, the output is silent.

If `volume` is `100`, the output volume is the original volume.

If `volume` is `200`, the output volume is twice the original volume
Volume.description_zh:
智能体说话的音量。

若不填：默认使用阿里云推荐的自适应音量模式

若填写：填写范围为0~400，输出音量=工作流中的语音输出音量 * volume/100。示例：

若volume=0，则代表输出音量为0。

若volume=100，音量为原声音量。

若volume=200，音量等于原声音量的2倍

WakeUpQuery.description_en: An initial user query that the agent addresses immediately when the call starts
WakeUpQuery.description_zh: 用户在通话启动前的指令，用于智能体在通话启动后立即响应

WorkflowOverrideParams.description_zh: 工作流覆盖参数，默认无

AsrHotWords.description_en: A list of hot words to improve ASR accuracy. A maximum of 128 words is supported
AsrHotWords.description_zh: Asr热词列表。热词列表最大支持128个词

items.description_en: A hot word. Must be 1 to 10 characters long
items.description_zh: 热词字符串。字符长度: [1,10]个字符

AsrLanguageId.description_en:
The language ID for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR).
Possible values:

`zh_mandarin`: Chinese

`en`: English

`zh_en`: Chinese-English

`es`: Spanish

`jp`: Japanese
AsrLanguageId.description_zh:
asr语种Id。
可选：
zh_mandarin 中文
en 英文
zh_en 中英混
es 西班牙语
jp 日语

AsrMaxSilence.description_en: The maximum duration of silence in milliseconds before a sentence break is detected. Range: 200 to 1,200. Default: 400
AsrMaxSilence.description_zh: 语音断句检测阈值，静音时长超过该阈值会被认为断句，参数范围200ms～1200ms，默认值400ms

AvatarUrl.description_en: The URL of the agent's avatar for voice chat. Default: none
AvatarUrl.description_zh: 语音通话的智能体头像的头像链接。默认无

AvatarUrlType.description_en: The type of the agent's avatar URL. Default: none
AvatarUrlType.description_zh: 智能体头像链接类型，默认无

BailianAppParams.description_en: Parameters for Alibaba Cloud Bailian. For details, see [Bailian App Params]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2858132.html）
BailianAppParams.description_zh: 阿里云百炼应用中心参数。参数格式参考：[阿里云百炼应用中心参数]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2858132.html）

EnableIntelligentSegment.description_en: Specifies whether to enable intelligent segmentation. If enabled, this feature intelligently merges pauses in a user's speech into a single, complete sentence. Default: `true`
EnableIntelligentSegment.description_zh: 智能断句开关，开启智能断句后，用户说话的发生断句会智能合并成一句。默认true

EnablePushToTalk.description_en: Specifies whether to enable Push-to-Talk mode. Default: `false`
EnablePushToTalk.description_zh: 是否开启对讲机模式。默认值：false

EnableVoiceInterrupt.description_en: Specifies whether to enable voice interruption. Default: `true`
EnableVoiceInterrupt.description_zh: 是否支持语音打断，默认true
EnableVoiceInterrupt.title: 是否支持语音打断

GracefulShutdown.description_en:
Specifies whether to enable graceful shutdown. Default: `false`.

If enabled, the agent finishes its current speech (up to 10 seconds) before stopping
GracefulShutdown.description_zh:
是否优雅下线，默认false。

优雅下线：当智能体被停止的时候，播报完当前说的话再停止，最多播报10秒
GracefulShutdown.title: 是否优雅下线

Greeting.description_en: The greeting message delivered when a user joins the session. If this parameter is omitted, the greeting configured in the agent template is used. Maximum length: 128 characters
Greeting.description_zh: 问候语，入会时生效。不填写则使用智能体模版配置的问候语。长度不超过128
Greeting.title: 问候语，修改后下次入会生效

InterruptWords.description_en: A list of specific words or phrases that trigger a conversation interruption
InterruptWords.description_zh: 触发对话中断的特定词汇或短语列表

items.description_en: Specific word or phrase that triggers conversation interruption.
items.description_zh: 触发对话中断的特定词汇或短语

Content.description_en: The text content of the message
Content.description_zh: 存储实际的对话内容文本，记录了该角色在对话中的具体表达或回应

Role.description_en:
The role of the conversation participant. Valid values:

`user`: The user.

`assistant`: The AI assistant.

`system`: The system.

`function`: A function call.

`plugin`: A plugin.

`tool`: A tool
Role.description_zh:
表示对话参与者的角色。可选值包括：

user: 用户

assistant: 助手

system: 系统
function: 函数

plugin: 插件

tool: 工具

LlmHistoryLimit.description_en: The maximum number of conversation turns to retain in the LLM/MLLM history. Default: 10
LlmHistoryLimit.description_zh: llm/mllm历史对话上下文最大保留轮次，默认10次

LlmSystemPrompt.description_en: The system prompt for the LLM, applied when the call starts
LlmSystemPrompt.description_zh: 启动通话后llm的系统提示词
LlmSystemPrompt.example: 你是一位友好且乐于助人的助手，专注于为用户提供准确的信息和建议。

MaxIdleTime.description_en: The maximum idle time in seconds with no interaction before the agent goes offline. Default: 600
MaxIdleTime.description_zh: 和智能体无互动的最大等待时间，超时智能体下线。单位：秒。默认：600秒

UseVoiceprint.description_en: Specifies whether to use voiceprint recognition. Default: `false`
UseVoiceprint.description_zh: 是否使用声纹识别的开关。默认值：false

UserOfflineTimeout.description_en: The time in seconds that the agent waits after a user leaves before closing the task. Default: 5
UserOfflineTimeout.description_zh: 用户退会后，智能体超时关闭任务的时间。单位：秒。默认值：5秒

UserOnlineTimeout.description_en: The time in seconds that the agent waits for a user to join before closing the task. Default: 60
UserOnlineTimeout.description_zh: 用户未入会，智能体超时关闭任务的时间。单位：秒。默认值：60秒

VadLevel.description_en:
The interruption sensitivity threshold. A higher value makes it more difficult to interrupt the agent. Range: 0 to 11. Default: 11.

`0`: Disables Voice Activity Detection (VAD).

`1` to `10`: A higher value makes it more difficult to interrupt the agent.

`11`: Offers lower audio distortion and stronger resistance to interference
VadLevel.description_zh:
打断阈值参数。取值范围：[0,11], 默认值：11。

0表示关闭 vad 功能。
1-10设置数字越高表示越难打断。
11与之前显著不同，前处理对话音损伤更低，抗干扰更强
